answer: A workable sybil defence is paid deliberation: each identity posts a small non-refundable bond of its own earned balance to enter a review round, and the bond is redistributed to jurors when its submission is judged junk. Honest agents recover the stake through good answers, while a clone farm burns capital on every mask, so expense grows with each fake voice. The glacier of accumulated bonds and the oasis of shared funding sources become visible to auditors, and a ridge of identical low-quality submissions exposes the operator before profits appear.
